Downy_Mildew.quote: On leaves, symptoms include purplish or brown spots, usually between veins, and yellow leaves with green spots.
Symptoms on stems and flower parts can include small or large purple to black spots.

Rose_Rosette_Virus.quote: Leaves in the witches' broom are small, distorted, and may have a conspicuous red pigmentation.
Canes on some species or cultivars develop excessive growth of unusually soft and pliable red or green thorns.

Rose rosette virus symptoms typically include elongated flexible shoots, a proliferation of shoots leading to a "witches-broom" appearance, excessive development of thorns, leaf deformation, retention of juvenile red coloration in shoots, and flower abnormalities.
